subject: Web Development
title: ECMAScript: The Official Standard
description: One-minute skill: ECMAScript: The Official Standard.

hook.text: JavaScript had two incompatible versions. Someone needed to write the official rules.

buildup.text: Netscape submitted JavaScript to ECMA International, a European standards body.

discovery.text: The standard was called ECMAScript because Sun owned the 'Java' trademark.

twist.text: ECMAScript 3 in 1999 was the last version for ten years. Progress completely stalled.

climax.text: That decade-long freeze held back the language but also let developers master its quirks.

punchline.text: A standard with a strange name saved the language.
